headline: Renames the VA community-based outpatient clinic in Butte, Montana, as the Charlie Dowd VA Clinic.
what_it_does: This law changes the official name of the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Butte, Montana. The clinic will now be called the Charlie Dowd Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic, or the Charlie Dowd VA Clinic. The law does not change the clinic's services, staff, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect on enactment, July 30, 2024.
